raw_problem.problem_text:
质量分别为 $\mathbf { m } _ { 1 } , \mathbf { m } _ { 2 }$ 的两个粒子组成的体系，质心座标 $\vec { R }$ 及相对座 标 $\vec { r }$ 为：

$$
\vec {R} = \frac {m _ {1} \vec {r} _ {1} + m _ {2} \vec {r} _ {2}}{m _ {1} + m _ {2}} \tag {1}
$$

$$
r \vec {r} = \vec {r} _ {2} - \vec {r} _ {1} \tag {2}
$$

试求总动量 $\vec { P } = \vec { p } _ { 1 } + \vec { p } _ { 2 }$ 及总角动量 $\begin{array} { r } { \vec { L } = \vec { l } _ { 1 } ^ { \mathrm { ~ ~ } } + \vec { l } _ { 2 } ^ { \mathrm { ~ ~ } } } \end{array}$ 在 $\vec { R }$ , $\vec { r }$ 表象中的

算符表示。

1.
raw_problem.solution_text:
（a）合动量算符 $\vec { P } = \vec { p } _ { 1 } + \vec { p } _ { 2 }$ 。根据假设可以解出 $\vec { r } _ { 1 }$ ， $\vec { r } _ { 2 }$

令 $m \equiv m _ { 1 } + m _ { 2 }$ ： r R   1   ${ \vec { r } } _ { 1 } = { \vec { R } } - { \frac { m _ { 2 } } { m } } { \vec { r } }$ （3）

$$
\vec {r} _ {2} = \vec {R} + \frac {m _ {1}}{m _ {2}} \vec {r} \tag {4}
$$

设各个矢量的分量是 $\vec { r } _ { 1 } ( x _ { 1 } , y _ { 1 } , z _ { 1 } )$ ， $\vec { r } _ { 2 } ( x _ { 2 , } y _ { 2 } , z _ { 2 } )$

$\vec { r } ( x , y , z )$ 和 $\vec { R } ( X , Y , Z )$ 。为了计算动量的变换式先求对 $x _ { 1 }$

$x _ { 2 }$ 等的偏导数：

$$
\frac {\partial}{\partial x _ {1}} = \frac {\partial X}{\partial x _ {1}} \frac {\partial}{\partial X} + \frac {\partial x}{\partial x _ {1}} \frac {\partial}{\partial x} = \frac {m _ {1}}{m} \frac {\partial}{\partial X} - \frac {\partial}{\partial x} \tag {5}
$$

$$
\frac {\partial}{\partial x _ {2}} = \frac {\partial X}{\partial x _ {2}} \frac {\partial}{\partial X} + \frac {\partial x}{\partial x _ {2}} \frac {\partial}{\partial x} = \frac {m _ {2}}{m} \frac {\partial}{\partial X} + \frac {\partial}{\partial x} \tag {6}
$$

关于 $\frac { \hat { \sigma } } { \hat { \sigma } y _ { 1 } } , \frac { \hat { \sigma } } { \hat { \sigma } y _ { 2 } } , \frac { \hat { \sigma } } { \hat { \sigma } z _ { 1 } } , \frac { \hat { \sigma } } { \hat { \sigma } z _ { 2 } }$ 可以写出与（5）（6）类似的式子，因而：1z 2z

$$
\begin{array}{l} \hat {P} _ {x} = \left(\hat {\bar {p}} _ {1} + \hat {\bar {p}} _ {2}\right) _ {x} = \hat {p} _ {1 x} + \hat {p} _ {2 x} = \frac {\hbar}{i} \left(\frac {\partial}{\partial x _ {1}} + \frac {\partial}{\partial x _ {2}}\right) \\ = \frac {\hbar}{i} \left(\frac {m _ {1}}{m} \frac {\partial}{\partial X} - \frac {\partial}{\partial x} + \frac {m _ {2}}{m} \frac {\partial}{\partial X} + \frac {\partial}{\partial x}\right) = \frac {\hbar}{i} \frac {\partial}{\partial X} \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\hat {\vec {P}} = \vec {i} \frac {\hbar}{i} \frac {\partial}{\partial X} + \vec {j} \frac {\hbar}{i} \frac {\partial}{\partial Y} + \vec {k} \frac {\hbar}{i} \frac {\partial}{\partial Z} = \frac {\hbar}{i} \nabla_ {R}
$$

(b)总角动量 $\hat { \boldsymbol { L } } = \hat { \Vec { l } _ { 1 } } + \hat { \Vec { l _ { 2 } } } = \frac { \hbar } { i } ( \Vec { r _ { 1 } } \times \nabla _ { 1 } + \Vec { r _ { 2 } } \times \nabla _ { 2 } )$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \hat {\bar {L}} _ {x} = \frac {\hbar}{i} \left(\bar {r} _ {1} \times \nabla_ {1} + \bar {r} _ {2} \times \nabla_ {2}\right) _ {x} \\ = \frac {\hbar}{i} \left(y _ {1} \frac {\partial}{\partial z _ {1}} - z _ {1}\right) + \frac {\hbar}{i} \left(y _ {2} \frac {\partial}{\partial z _ {2}} - z _ {2} \frac {\partial}{\partial y _ {2}}\right) \\ \end{array}
$$

利用（3），（4），（5），（6）：

$$
\begin{array}{l} \hat {L} _ {x} = \frac {\hbar}{i} \left\{\left(Y - \frac {m _ {2}}{m} y\right) \left(\frac {m _ {1}}{m} \frac {\partial}{\partial Z} - \frac {\partial}{\partial z}\right) \right. \\ - (Z - \frac {m _ {2}}{m} z) (\frac {m _ {1}}{m} \frac {\partial}{\partial Y} - \frac {\partial}{\partial y}) \\ + (Y + \frac {m _ {1}}{m} y) (\frac {m _ {2}}{m} \frac {\partial}{\partial Z} + \frac {\partial}{\partial z}) \\ - \left(Z + \frac {m _ {1}}{m} z\right) \left(\frac {m _ {2}}{m} \frac {\partial}{\partial Y} + \frac {\partial}{\partial y}\right) \} \\ = \frac {\hbar}{i} \left\{\frac {m _ {1}}{m} \left(Y \frac {\partial}{\partial Z} - Z \frac {\partial}{\partial Y}\right) - \left(Y \frac {\partial}{\partial z} - Z \frac {\partial}{\partial y}\right) \right. \\ - \frac {m _ {1} m _ {2}}{m} \left(y \frac {\partial}{\partial Z} - z \frac {\partial}{\partial Y}\right) + \frac {m _ {2}}{m} \left(y \frac {\partial}{\partial z} - z \frac {\partial}{\partial y}\right) \\ + \frac {m _ {2}}{m} (Y \frac {\partial}{\partial Z} - Z \frac {\partial}{\partial Y}) + (Y \frac {\partial}{\partial z} - Z \frac {\partial}{\partial y}) \\ + \frac {m _ {1} m _ {2}}{m _ {2}} \left(y \frac {\partial}{\partial Z} - z \frac {\partial}{\partial Y}\right) + \frac {m _ {2}}{m} \left(y \frac {\partial}{\partial z} - z \frac {\partial}{\partial y}\right) \} \\ = \frac {\hbar}{i} \left\{\left(Y \frac {\partial}{\partial Z} - Z \frac {\partial}{\partial Y}\right) + \left(y \frac {\partial}{\partial z} - z \frac {\partial}{\partial y}\right) \right\} \\ = \left(\frac {\hbar}{i} \vec {R} \times \nabla_ {R} + \frac {\hbar}{i} \vec {r} \times \nabla_ {r}\right) _ {x} \\ \end{array}
$$

因而 $\stackrel { \wedge } { \cal L } = \frac { \hbar } { i } \vec { R } \times \nabla _ { \scriptscriptstyle R } + \frac { \hbar } { i } \vec { r } \times \nabla _ { \scriptscriptstyle r }$
